'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Kendall Halman DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kendall Halman]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Deck that Abby Plays.
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
